title: Fix Tree Nesting in Detail Panel
description: Fixed TreeContent paddingLeft to account for chevron+gap offset so child items render correctly indented under their parent labels in the detail panel
summary: Fixed two root causes: (1) TreeContent paddingLeft formula missing chevron+gap offset, (2) CSS override forcing pl-0 important on all tree-content in right panel. Removed override, corrected formula. 13/13 unit tests pass.
